lines: You turned around... and it was already inside.
And every camera in the city... wakes up.
You run the other way. It's there too.
It can go anywhere a camera can see you.
There's only one place in this city with no cameras.
Your phone buzzes. A live feed... of you.
There are no cameras down here.
For three days, nothing moved. Now... the train does.
You're not alone on this train.
